note: Exact PTFS coordinate frames. 'game' is the ground-chart unit of 24RC / 24Radar (1 unit = 100 studs, x east, y south), in which 24RC's coast.svg is drawn. gridFromGame: [[a,-b,tx],[b,a,ty]] -> radar world grid nm, fitted on 11 island centroids against the radar's world-map picture (residuals 3-60 m). spyFromGame: same form -> 24SPY map units (1200 x 1200), fitted on 7 island centroids against 24SPY's map tiles (residuals ~1 unit = 0.03 nm). Built from the fits described in scripts/import-24spy.js.
